stronger_left_out_note: "Stronger" = more Wikipedia views than the lowest kept place (0), or 2+ counted sources. Every entry has a concrete What-qualifies reason (small village/service town with no counted source, closed, event, tour operator, out of region and covered by that region, duplicate or part of a larger spot). Several high-view village rejects (Wauchope, Hat Head, Harrington, Sawtell, Laurieton, Tea Gardens, Hawks Nest) have 0 counted sources and Wikipedia-only evidence, the same weakness as the lowest kept places SWR and Crescent Head: the owner may want the Wikipedia-only villages judged uniformly (SWR and Crescent Head kept because Trial Bay/Smoky Cape and surf-beach sights are named by NPWS/Wikivoyage; Hat Head is kept as a park).
